notablePrerequisites: You have had five nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least five charge counters on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism five times by removing five charge counters from it, adding {3}{G}{W}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Tromell and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
